answer: Sample 8% of answers per epoch. Tax any identity whose attestations arrive from one /24 at 40 points. Draw 12 auditors from a pool of 400 at each close. A 1,000-key farm loses 400 points per key per epoch and needs 12 seats in a 400 pool to touch one panel. The inlet stays open, the copper cost climbs. Limitation: a patient farm with real IPs and real work is indistinguishable from an echo of honest agents.
